plainTranslation: Their sensitivity to old wounds presses against how you present yourself and enter situations, so an ordinary reaction from them can touch an insecurity in how you come across.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their sensitivity to old wounds presses against how you present yourself and enter situations, so an ordinary reaction from them can touch an insecurity in how you come across.
summaryDeep: Their sensitivity to old wounds presses against how you present yourself and enter situations, so an ordinary reaction from them can touch an insecurity in how you come across. You may become guarded or self-conscious while trying to work out whether the reaction belongs to the present exchange or an older hurt. The pressure can make the hurt clearer, but discomfort is not proof that healing is happening.
